Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Chevron Wool Runner Rug, 2' 6" x 8', Blue, Green, Ivory
Colors: Blue, Green, Ivory
Materials: wool
New style chevron in blue, green and ivory will enliven your space with color and pattern. This vibrant runner will define a conversation area and add a focal point to your hallway. The soft wool blend is easy to maintain. 2' 6" x 8' Loop construction is easy to maintain. Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
